name: com.byazt.bis.DownloadHandlerService
description: When someone taps an ad download notification or storage becomes available again, the Yodo1 MAS 4399 TT ad plugin handles opening, pausing, resuming, or deleting the Pangle ad download.
disableEffect: Pangle ad downloads may not resume, install, or respond to their notification controls; the app's own screens remain available.
